{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for -999 in biomarker_baseline
print(f"Number of -999 in biomarker_baseline: {df['biomarker_baseline'].eq(-999).sum()}")
print(f"Proportion of -999: {df['biomarker_baseline'].eq(-999).mean():.3f}")

# Check for duplicate patient_id
print(f"Number of duplicate patient_id: {df['patient_id'].duplicated().sum()}")
print(f"Unique patient_id count: {df['patient_id'].nunique()}")

# Check association between arm and severity
tab = pd.crosstab(df['arm'], df['severity'], margins=True)
print("\nCross-tab of arm vs severity:")
print(tab)

# Display the proportion of severe patients in each arm
prop_severe_treatment = df.loc[df['arm'] == 'treatment', 'severity'].eq('severe').mean()
prop_severe_control = df.loc[df['arm'] == 'control', 'severity'].eq('severe').mean()
print(f"\nProportion severe in treatment arm: {prop_severe_treatment:.3f}")
print(f"Proportion severe in control arm: {prop_severe_control:.3f}")"}
